summary: Completed provider-migration regression for backend and frontend with public endpoint validation, SDK contract tests, clean-venv install/import checks, and UI sanity checks.
action_items: No functional regression found in tested migration scope.
Optional: keep existing historical tests separate; they include legacy hardcoded preview URLs unrelated to this migration.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed a runtime upload retrieval bug in /app/backend/routers/uploads.py where stream.close() was awaited unconditionally and raised TypeError for sync close implementations.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned temporary assistant leads, assistant usage/session docs, and GridFS upload records during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration regression suite is now at /app/backend/tests/test_provider_migration.py and uses official AsyncOpenAI SDK with httpx.MockTransport for provider behavior coverage (MOCKED provider network only in tests). Public preview checks verified keyless AI controlled errors, settings/programs/products snapshot parity, GridFS upload/download parity, and frontend assistant/settings behavior.
rca of the issue: RCA: /api/files/{path} returned 502 after upload due to a close-method mismatch in GridFS download cleanup; stream.close() can be synchronous and was being awaited. Repro: upload image via /api/admin/uploads then GET returned file URL caused TypeError and 502. Mitigation: call close(), then await only if coroutine. Verified byte-for-byte retrieval and content-type pass after fix.
